decommit_dv.definition: C2 (load-bearing, WITHIN-ARM, part b) = on ARM_CLOSURE_ON, mean post-closure beta-latch occupancy fraction < mean pre-closure occupancy fraction with a >= DECOMMIT_MIN_DROP_FRAC relative drop, over >= C2_MIN_WINDOW_EVENTS scored CLOSURE_WINDOW-tick windows with mean_pre_occ > WITHIN_PRE_OCC_FLOOR. Paired within-arm around-closure statistic -- replaces 460f's underpowered between-arm unpaired mean comparison (retained as a secondary diagnostic: between_arm_drop).

magnitude_lever.note: Leg-B refractory scales with committed-run length (460f amend, ree-v3 main 2cd0aa2) so the de-commit authority scales with the natural-commit latch occupancy it must overcome.

interpretation.coupling_certifier_note: 460h gates non-vacuity on the REFRACTORY-INDEPENDENT sd034_n_closure_commit_intent (counted before the elevate/refractory gate), NOT sd034_n_closure_coupled_elevations -- which the 460g committed-run-scaled de-commit-magnitude lever pinned the refractory at cap and suppressed (36 -> 0 on seed 42) even though the de-commit acted. The coupled-elevation counter is retained as a secondary diagnostic so the suppression is visible to review.
